Chocolate Pudding Recipe - Rave Diet
By: DominikaZR
Published: Monday, March 7, 2011 - 3:36pm

Ingredients




2 cups cold water
1/2 cup maple syrup
4 tablespoons cornstarch or corn flour
3 tablespoons cocoa powder
1 teaspoon vanilla
chopped and roasted hazelnuts for topping

Preparation

1 Combine water, maple syrup, cocoa, cornstarch or corn flour and vanilla together in a saucepan. 2 Whisk smooth with a spoon or hand whisker. 3 Cook over medium heat and stir constantly until pudding is very thick. 4 Pour into dessert dishes and top with chopped hazelnuts. 5 Cool and serve.

About


Ingredients in the chocolate pudding recipe are a bit "unusual" or better say "a bit different" from what most of us use for that kind of a dessert, and that's exactly the main point of the Rave diet anyway. Cold water, maple syrup, corn starch or corn flour, cocoa and vanilla are ingredients which give this dessert an absolutely fantastic taste. I went even further and added roasted and chopped hazelnuts for topping. Short preparation and cooking times are another "good" property of this yummy and simple recipe.
